title: PublicFormSchemaResponse
description: Response body of GET /api/dashboards/:dashboardId/panels/:panelId/form-schema (HEL-1587), readable behind the dashboard's sharing gate (share token, public dashboard or grant): ONLY the fields the form binds (`config.fields[].sourceField`), in the dataset's declared order, as exactly name/type/required. No `default`, no row, no data source id, no row cap and no owner id. A non-form panel, a panel of another dashboard, an unknown panel and a missing dataset (or one the form's owner does not own) all answer the same 404.
